name: Actinide decorporation and radiological/nuclear countermeasures
problem_set: Removing internalized plutonium, uranium and other actinides after exposure
Preparedness and countermeasure development for radiological or nuclear emergencies
Analytical and quality methods for chelator candidates
value_prop: Tentatively, the founder's preclinical work on orally active HOPO actinide decorporation agents (3,4,3-LI(1,2-HOPO), 5-LIO(Me-3,2-HOPO)), reported as outperforming DTPA with scale-up-ready synthesis and analytical methods, may be relevant to groups studying chelation therapy and countermeasures.

name: HOPO and chelator chemistry for radiopharmaceuticals and imaging
problem_set: Stable chelation of metal radionuclides (e.g. Zr-89, Th-227) for PET imaging and targeted alpha therapy
Characterizing radionuclide coordination chemistry for radiopharmaceutical design
value_prop: Tentatively, the founder's hydroxypyridonate ligand synthesis and analytical work may be of interest to teams working with HOPO-based chelation in radiopharmaceutical settings, though the supplied founder work does not itself address imaging or therapy applications.

name: Actinide and f-element coordination chemistry and ligand design
problem_set: Understanding f-element and actinide binding geometry and selectivity
Modeling and designing chelating ligands for actinides and lanthanides
value_prop: Tentatively, the founder's characterized HOPO actinide chelators may serve as a reference ligand class for groups studying actinide coordination, though the quotes show basic-science focus rather than a stated product need.
